steps.content: In the vast, expansive white fog, the screaming chicken named Bass is standing in place.
He seems to have been waiting for you to return here all along.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Did you come to show me your memories?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: After seeing them, will I have the answer to solve everything?
He doesn't answer, but turns around and runs into the depths of the white fog. You can only follow.
However, at the end of the white fog, you see a scene filled with blood, gun smoke, and contamination.

steps.speaker: Bass
steps.content: Bad guys! There are bad guys! Run, Eve!!!

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Huh? What happened?

steps.speaker: Bass
steps.content: Can't tell Eve! The factory is in huge debt! It's getting worse! Gangsters are coming for money! But we can't tell Eve!

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: The factory... I'm also a member of the factory. Why didn't you tell me...

steps.speaker: Bass
steps.content: Ahhhh! Disaster! Eve found out!

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Where are the debt collectors? ...Let go of me, Maresa.

steps.speaker: Maresa
steps.content: You can't go! Child... I can't lose another child...

steps.speaker: Polly
steps.content: That's right! We can fix this! Everything will get better!

steps.speaker: Polly
steps.content: Listen, leave this place! It's safe outside!

steps.speaker: Benna
steps.content: Shanna, be good. Grandpa will buy you a ball to play with...

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Everyone...

steps.speaker: Bass
steps.content: Go, Benna! Beat the bad guys! They've got huge, huge guns! Purple ones! With black smoke!

steps.speaker: Benna
steps.content: There are times when this old man is useful too...

steps.speaker: Bone
steps.content: Woof, woof, woof!

steps.speaker: Benna
steps.content: Good boy, Bone. You come with us, too.

steps.speaker: Polly
steps.content: Eve, leave this to us! You can escape from the back door of the depot!

steps.speaker: Polly
steps.content: Say hello to my mom, dad and little brother for me.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Polly, wait! Let go of me! Put me down!

steps.speaker: Maresa
steps.content: No! This time, I must keep an eye on my child!

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Wake up, Maresa. I'm not your child!

steps.speaker: Maresa
steps.content: Yes, you are! I'm wide awake... You're all my children!

steps.speaker: Maresa
steps.content: Go, remember to find him for me...

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: ...Nooo...
The memories of the toy family members reach their end. The explosion of mania weapons devour everything.
You find yourself back in the white fog, but Bass is nowhere to be seen.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Are these Eve's memories? What should I do?
As you ask, you feel your way through the white fog.
From afar, you see several unfamiliar figures who seem to be gathered together, chatting about something.

steps.speaker: Maresa
steps.content: Eve has been working very hard these years to keep all these things as they are...

steps.speaker: Bass
steps.content: Dummy Eve. Eve is a dummy! Locking herself in the toy factory!

steps.speaker: Polly
steps.content: But it's already happened... Time won't really stop. Bone won't have another birthday.

steps.speaker: Bone
steps.content: Whimper...

steps.speaker: Maresa
steps.content: We're the ones who held her back, right? She must know that we can't bear to lose her.

steps.speaker: Benna
steps.content: Yes... Eve is the smartest child I've ever met...

steps.speaker: Bone
steps.content: Woof!

steps.speaker: Polly
steps.content: Benna! You said that word again!

steps.speaker: Bass
steps.content: Child! Child! Child!

steps.speaker: Maresa
steps.content: No matter what kind of injustice or discomfort she encountered, she would boldly express her feelings and then bravely resist.

steps.speaker: Maresa
steps.content: We've all... moved on.

steps.speaker: Polly
steps.content: Eve will surely move on too!

steps.speaker: Polly
steps.content: There are many things ahead of her that we have never seen or experienced.

steps.speaker: Bass
steps.content: Quick! Make a wish! The power of wishes! ${PlayerName} said so!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Me?

It's as if there is a thick wall between you and them. No one notices you approaching, and no one pays you any attention. They act as if they're simply sitting on the floor of their home, casually chatting amongst themselves.

steps.speaker: Polly
steps.content: Right! Bass is so smart!

steps.speaker: Polly
steps.content: I wish that in my next life, I'll meet Eve again! By then, we will be complete, healthy and well.

steps.speaker: Benna
steps.content: Next life, huh... It feels so far away, yet so near...

steps.speaker: Bass
steps.content: Benna, make a wish too!

steps.speaker: Benna
steps.content: All right. Then I wish that in this life, Eve can leave the factory, and live a long, happy and peaceful life.

steps.speaker: Bass
steps.content: You're not wishing for Shanna? Benna forgot again!

steps.speaker: Benna
steps.content: How could I forget? The one who chatted with me... the one who I watched grow up... is Eve.

steps.speaker: Bass
steps.content: Bass hope Eve can make new friends! Friends smarter than Bass, so Eve won't be troubled! If Eve is happy, Bass is happy!

steps.speaker: Bone
steps.content: Woof, woof! Woof, woof, woof, woof!

steps.speaker: Polly
steps.content: Does Bone want to make a wish too?

steps.speaker: Maresa
steps.content: Bone still remembers its promise with Eve.

steps.speaker: Maresa
steps.content: It wishes that it can go for a walk with Eve... and be Eve's puppy again.

steps.speaker: Polly
steps.content: Go for a walk... That sounds nice. It'd be great if we could all go together.

steps.speaker: Maresa
steps.content: Then let me make the last wish. I hope, all our wishes can come true.

steps.speaker: Maresa
steps.content: Let ${PlayerName} bear witness to these wishes coming true on our behalf. He's the only one around here who can see things through to the end.
steps.female_content: Let ${PlayerName} bear witness to these wishes coming true on our behalf. She's the only one around here who can see things through to the end.

steps.content: Everyone, including Bone, suddenly turns to look at you. Even though their faces are blurry, you can clearly sense their smiles.
Then, an aged group photo ends up in your palm.

steps.speaker: All the Toys
steps.content: Please, take her away from here.
The photo in your hand emits a warmth that doesn't belong to this time and space.

options: Don't worry, I will. You have my words.
